question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

If you try to do something every day you will ______ progress.
solution:
The correct answer is: **make**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning and proper use of the given words.
 
 
• **Hold**: An act or manner of grasping something; a grip. (किसी वस्तु को पकड़ने की क्रिया या ढंग; एक पकड़)
 
• **Get**: To obtain, buy, or earn something. (कुछ प्राप्त करना, खरीदना या अर्जित करना)
 
• **Make**: To create, to force, or to cause to happen. (बनाने के लिए, मजबूर करने के लिए, या होने का कारण)
 
• **Catch**: To take or get hold of a moving object, or to hold and prevent someone from getting away. (किसी चलती हुई वस्तु को पकड़ना या पकड़ना या किसी को दूर जाने से रोकना)
 
 
 
• In English "**Progress**" is an uncountable noun. We most commonly use it with the verb "**make**."
 
• "**Make progress**" means to move forward in one's work or activity.
 
 
• **Example -** *We're not finished yet, but we're making progress.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate option is "**make**" to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Complete sentence:** *If you try to do something every day you will make __progress.*
